entities.summary: Kai Martinez Jones is a Bahamian professional basketball player for Anadolu Efes of the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroLeague. He previously played in the NBA for the Charlotte Hornets and Dallas Mavericks. He played college basketball for the Texas Longhorns.
